title: Concept: PostgreSQL URI naming an internal host
description: A postgres URI that names the database host in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The URI names the engine and the host, which is the addressing an attacker needs to try a direct connection once the network allows it.
applicability: Deployments that render a postgres URI that names the database host into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The URI names the engine and the host, which is the addressing an attacker needs to try a direct connection once the network allows it.
